metadataRaw.title: How to SAFELY Crack Your Full Back
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy stretching exercises that may end in a satisfying self pop, crack, or release throughout the full back. 

To make it easy, we'll break the video up into separate parts. Each part will focus on a different area of the back, that way you can quickly target the spots that need it the most.

As a bonus, all of these mobility exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give quick back pain relief... even within SECONDS!

Watch now and self pop your whole back at home!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:52 Base of Neck
2:53 Upper Back 
4:32 Upper and Middle Back Exercise 1
7:00 Upper and Middle Back Exercise 2
8:50 Lower Back
10:56 Pelvis and Sacroiliac (SI) Joint
